China, Laos, Myanmar and Thailand kicked off their 170th joint Mekong River patrol on October 19. Chinese patrol boats set out from the Jingha police wharf in Xishuangbanna, Yunnan Province, to rendezvous with vessels from Laos and Myanmar. Commanders from all four countries are jointly leading the operation.
